## Primary Specializations & Services
1. **Luxury Wedding Photography:** Editorial candid photography, traditional rituals, Sabyasachi bridal couture portraiture.
2. **4K Anamorphic Wedding Cinematography:** True 2.39:1 widescreen optical cinema, cinema cameras, DaVinci Resolve color grading, custom sound design.
3. **Pre-Wedding Shoots & Concept Films:** Destination love stories at heritage Havelis, palaces, and scenic landscapes across Gujarat and Rajasthan.
4. **Professional Photo Editing & Retouching:** Magazine-grade beauty and skin retouching, archival color calibration.
5. **Cinematic Video Editing & Post-Production:** Multi-cam synchronization, 4K reel editing, narrative feature film editing.
6. **Handcrafted Heirloom Albums:** Bespoke Italian leather lay-flat albums with non-tearable metallic archival prints.
